gloss: to start dating; to begin associating with

definitions.gloss: to start going out with someone; to begin a relationship or association
definitions.explanation: To begin a romantic relationship, or more generally to start keeping company with a person or group. A compound of {付|つ}き{合|あ}う (to associate with, to date) and {始|はじ}める (to begin).

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The two of them started dating last month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}めて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's been half a year since I started going out with her.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦サークル→サークル：10933_saakuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}めて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しく→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Since I started spending time with friends from the same club, my weekends have become more fun.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ichidan verb. The partner is marked with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: (person)⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}める. A compound of ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}う→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧ plus the auxiliary {始|はじ}める (to begin doing).

USAGE:
- Most often means to enter a romantic relationship, but can also mean simply to begin associating with people or a group.
- The plain past {付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}めた is common when stating when a relationship began.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}める: to start dating him
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}い{始|はじ}めた⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: to have only just started going out
